image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a metallic disposable lighter lying on its side on a rough concrete surface. The lighter has a silver/chrome finish with black accents near the top. The ignition wheel and nozzle are clearly visible in the foreground. The background is blurred (bokeh), showing hints of greenery and a brick structure.

artifact_observations.location: Black band/label area on the lighter body
artifact_observations.reasoning: The black section near the top has a slightly smudged or indistinct texture compared to the sharp metallic reflections. It lacks clear branding or distinct pattern details, appearing somewhat 'melted' into the chrome, which is a common minor AI artifact in rendering printed labels on reflective surfaces.

The background blur is very smooth and uniform. While likely intended as depth-of-field, the transition between the sharp foreground concrete and the blurred background is slightly abrupt, though not definitively an error.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'black band' on the lighter. In AI images, text or logos on curved metallic surfaces often distort or melt. Verify if this is just a generic design or a failed attempt at branding. Also, check if the flint wheel's teeth are mechanically plausible (uniform spacing) or if they merge into the body.
